message: No detected input validation: The only input check is verifying Content-Type is 'application/json'; there is no validation of the structure, types, or value ranges of the parsed JSON fields (player1, player2, surface) before use.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching with integrity verification (checksums, signed URLs, pinned revisions) is visible in the code; data is read from local CSV files and a local model file without any integrity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, validation of label values against an expected set, or label-noise detection tools are present anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads CSV data and feeds it directly into training without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded directly from a local file path './data/saved_model.h5' with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.
No detected label distribution validation: The code reads the CSV and splits it directly into train/test without any check on class balance or label distribution before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The model is trained with a standard Adam optimizer via tf.keras without any differential privacy library or DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any custom adversarial stress tests anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is used, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., signing, hashing, or separate storage of the test set), only a single accuracy metric is reported, and no controls prevent the test set from being contaminated or metrics from being manipulated.

No detected input sanitization: The code only checks that Content-Type is 'application/json' but performs no validation of player names, surface values, input shapes, or ranges before passing them directly to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The prediction returned by data.make_prediction is immediately JSON-serialized and sent with no NaN guards, probability range checks, or sanity validation on the model output.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a tabular tennis match prediction model, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
